en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a stone arch bridge over a broad river, with trams and pedestrians crossing. On the far bank rises an ornate baroque cityscape with tall church towers and domes, dense multi‑story buildings, and monumental riverside facades. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the embankment and bridge; trees and grassy terraces appear in the foreground.
